subject: Oort cloud
hook: OORT CLOUD IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The Oort cloud is not actually a dense region of space; its objects are so far apart that 'neighboring' bodies are separated by tens of millions of kilometers.
angle_support: On this analysis, 'neighboring' objects in the outer cloud are separated by a significant fraction of 1 AU, tens of millions of kilometres.
title: The Oort Cloud Is Mostly Empty Space
description: Contrary to the dense swarm depicted in popular media, the Oort cloud is an incredibly sparse collection of objects spread across a massive volume of space.
narration: OORT CLOUD IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a dense, swirling swarm of icy debris surrounding our Sun. It was closer to a vast, empty expanse of nearly isolated, drifting, individual objects. Although trillions of planetesimals exist within this region, the scale is incomprehensible. Because it spans such a massive volume, neighboring bodies in the outer cloud are typically separated by tens of millions of kilometers of empty space. It is less like a cloud and more like a void.
